proposedEntry.title: Run the WrapSheets v1 migration
proposedEntry.summary: WrapSheets v1 migration needs --batch 200 and verification by schema version and row counts.
proposedEntry.body:
1. Run `npm run migrate:v1 -- --batch 200`. The default batch size deadlocks.
2. Verify schema_version=1 and that row counts match pre-migration expectations.
